limitations: Each ratio is weighted by reported engine cycles across attributed rows; missing ratios with positive cycles are excluded and counted.
AIC and AIV denominators differ and pipeline activities may overlap; ratios cannot be added, subtracted, or equated to full-chip utilization, hardware peak efficiency or wait time.
Known task temporal union is coverage of exported task intervals inside the source-inferred window, not proof that device is occupied or idle.
Duration sums and cross-rank means are not end-to-end critical path.
No causal attribution follows from low values alone.
